February, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13786
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10125 of 2023
Applicant :- Pintoo

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lucknow
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around five years ago, subsequently on 13.04.2023, an information was received that the daughter of the informant died.
The post mortem report indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and no other injury apart from the ligature mark are visible on the body of the deceased.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 17.04.2023.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

Pintoo vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100744286/
1 4.

entities.text: Pintoo vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the post mortem report on record and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before the death, the deceased was subjected to any mental and physical harassment in relation to the demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 17.04.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Pintoo be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 146 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Ramgaon, District Bahraich, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Arun  Pintoo vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100744286/
